acceptance_criteria.criterion: E38 baseline independently ratified
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_BASELINE.json created from actual repository state. git status confirms LOCAL==REMOTE at commit b47b678. E38 artifacts present in docs/evidence/e38/. Test environment documented.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All seven E38 gaps identified exactly from the official acceptance matrix
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_E38_AUDIT.json re-checks all 20 ACs from E38_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.json. E39_GAP_REGISTER.json extracts exact 7 NOT_VERIFIED ACs with details from audit.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Independent verification authority exists for claims requiring independence
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.json demonstrates independent verification of 6 E38 claims by separate Python script (not E38 execution engine). Producer (E38 harness) != Verifier (E39 script) separation proven.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Producer and verifier separation is demonstrated
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.json explicitly documents independence_rule for each verification: separate process, no shared code path, no shared memory, no shared agent instances. 6 claims verified independently.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Claim → Requirement → Artifact → Evidence → Verification chain is reconstructable
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json contains 27 nodes and 21 edges showing full traceability chain for multiple ACs. Traceability queries demonstrate reconstruction paths.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Evidence graph contains traceable relationships between the required entities
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json includes CLAIM, REQUIREMENT, TASK, ACTION, ARTIFACT, EVIDENCE, VERIFICATION nodes with typed edges. All required entity types represented and linked.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: At least one real E38 artifact is independently reverified
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.json: 3 artifacts independently reverified (e38_t1_discovery_report.md, e38_t2_analysis.md, verification_standard.py). All PASS with confidence 1.0.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: At least one real E38 result is reproduced from repository/input/command rather than reused from old output
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_REPRODUCIBILITY.json and E39_REPRODUCTION_TRACE.json: Fresh E38 test execution from repository at commit b47b678 produced 3 artifacts with EXACT SHA256 matches to original run.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Reproduction result is hashable/comparable and differences are surfaced rather than hidden
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_REPRODUCIBILITY.json shows side-by-side hash comparison. All 3 artifacts MATCH exactly. Non-deterministic elements (IDs, timestamps) documented separately. No differences hidden.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Human Gate decision is durable and reconstructable
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_HUMAN_GATE_TRACE.json: Decision APPROVED with full metadata (decision_id, mission_id, task_id, reason, options, selected_option, actor, timestamp, pre/post states, resume_condition). Reconstructable from event trace and sandbox artifact.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Failure → Recovery → Replan → Resume → Verify chain is independently reconstructable
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_RECOVERY_TRACE.json reconstructs full chain from E38 evidence. Documents gap in dependency update (AC-10) but chain itself is traceable from saved artifacts.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Duplicate verified work is prevented or explicitly detected
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_E38_AUDIT.json AC-11: All 10 original tasks completed exactly once. Recovery task is separate. No duplicate verification detected. E38_STATE_TRACE.json confirms unique task IDs.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: E36 provider limitation is accurately represented
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_BASELINE.json and E39_E38_AUDIT.json AC-19: E36 status documented as 'blocked by external provider (402 Payment Required)' not PASS. E38_FINAL_REPORT.md regression evidence says 'E34-E37 regression tests pass (verified separately)' with E36 correctly noted as blocked.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All E34/E35/E37 regressions remain passing
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E38 test output shows regression tests pass. E39_E38_AUDIT.json AC-19 confirms E34 (6/6), E35 (16/16), E37 (15/15) VERIFIED. E36 BLOCKED by provider.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No production execution path relies on hidden mocks or pre-generated evidence
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_E38_AUDIT.json AC-17: E38 uses ContextAgent (test harness mock) for all role tasks. OperationalImplementerAgent/OperationalVerifierAgent registered but not used for role tasks. This gap persists in E38 and is NOT fixed in E39 (scope: verify, not fix factory).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every VERIFIED claim has inspectable evidence
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.json: 6 claims verified, each with inspectable evidence (file paths, hash checks, criterion results). E39_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json provides traceability for all verified claims.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every evidence item identifies its source artifact and verification method
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json: Each EVIDENCE node has source_id linking to ARTIFACT. Each VERIFICATION node has evidence_id and checks array. E39_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.json: each verification lists verification_method and evidence.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: E39 final result is independently reproducible by rerunning the declared verification path
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_REPRODUCTION_TRACE.json documents step-by-step reproduction: git status → test exists → execute test → locate artifacts → hash → compare. All steps declared and executable.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No unresolved hard-stop exists
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39_BASELINE.json: LOCAL==REMOTE. Worktree clean (untracked only). E38 artifacts present. All E39 verification steps completed. No hard-stop conditions triggered.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Final factory state can distinguish CLAIMED / EVIDENCED / VERIFIED / REPRODUCED without conflating them
acceptance_criteria.evidence: E39 artifacts demonstrate four distinct states: CLAIMED (E38_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.json reported_status), EVIDENCED (E39_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json evidence nodes), VERIFIED (E39_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.json result=PASS), REPRODUCED (E39_REPRODUCIBILITY.json match=true). Each state has separate artifact.
